about_the_game:
■ Story

A psychological horror experience set in a secluded house deep within the forest.
Uncover the truth of your past through quiet exploration and unease.

■ Gameplay

A first-person exploration adventure.
Interact with objects and collect fragments of memory as you unravel the story.

■ Playtime

Approximately 15–30 minutes to complete.
Perfect for a short, immersive horror experience—even for newcomers.

■ Genre

Japanese Horror / Exploration Adventure

■ Unique Features

  • A completely monochrome world enhances the eerie silence and surreal atmosphere.

  • No cheap jump scares. Fear comes from the slow, creeping dread that builds as you explore.

  • A focus on psychological horror, using sound and space to instill a deep sense of discomfort.

■ Behind the Scenes

  • Developed by a 19-year-old student.

  • Entirely self-taught in both programming and design.

  • Completed in just two months with zero budget—a true passion project and debut title.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains the following intense and potentially disturbing content.

Graphic depictions of blood, bodily injury, corpses, and acts of killing.
Realistic and excessive violence, including acts against the elderly and dismemberment.
Scenes depicting suicide and criminal behavior, some of which may be perceived as sympathetic or glorified.
Use of mild to moderate vulgar language and occasional slurs.
Characters wearing revealing clothing.
Depictions of unauthorized or improper use of medical substances.

※This game does not contain explicit depictions of sexual violence, non-consensual sex, or substance abuse involving drugs or alcohol, but it does include symbolic and artistic representations of violence and death.
Viewer discretion is advised, especially for those sensitive to intense or disturbing themes.
